body.title: Add vibe-adapter.ts core: sc1/sc2 types, createVibeAdapter factory, and startTurn's request validation/refusal paths
body.summary: New, purely additive module src/shared/vibe-adapter.ts. Exports the sc1/sc2 types verbatim (VibeAdapterContext, VibeNewSession/VibeResumedSession, VibeTurnRequest, VibeTurnEvent, VibeTurnResult+VibeExitEvidence, VibeMcpToolIdentity) and createVibeAdapter(context, deps?) with injectable spawn/fs/process-group/clock seams, refusing construction when context.cwd is empty or not a directory. startTurn() validates the request shape and runs every refusal/mapping path BEFORE any subprocess spawns: the read-only refusal (refuses outright until s2's qualification exists), the read-only+approval-setting refusal, the new-session selection-catalog check surface, and the ordinary-session approval mapping (default/manual/edit-auto/auto). The re-homed VibeTurnError class (same refusal-marker shape structured-output.ts relies on) is defined here. Turn execution internals (event production, process-group cleanup, exit-evidence readback, naming) are a separate Task (t2) and are stubbed/deferred here -- nothing imports this module yet.
acceptanceChecks: createVibeAdapter throws when context.cwd is empty or not a directory, before any subprocess spawns
startTurn with mode:'read-only' refuses before any subprocess spawn, surfacing a reason (k1 fail-closed from s1; s2 will later make this conditional on qualification)
startTurn with mode:'read-only' and any approval setting refuses before dispatch
a new-session request's argv carries --model/--thinking only when the caller supplied them; a resumed-session request's type carries no selection fields
the ordinary approval mapping matches today's chat mapping: default/undefined adds no flag, manual maps to agent ask, edit-auto maps to agent accept-edits, auto maps to auto-approve
VibeTurnError is re-homed with the same constructor shape (dispatchState, sessionId, cause) structured-output.ts's instanceof check relies on
